result.description:
Employer -  Hidrive Group Pty Ltd


Position  : Full Time 
Location : Goulburn NSW
Salary     : $75,000 - $85,000 a year


Hidrive designs, manufactures and installs light, strong, fit-for-purpose service bodies for utes, trailers, and trucks — trusted by trades, industry and governments since 1993. Hidrive is Australia’s only service body manufacturer with a company-owned national installation network, and it designs, builds and installs fit-for-purpose service bodies for all trades and industries at our company-owned facilities in Adelaide, Brisbane, Goulburn, Melbourne, Perth and Sydney.

Hidrive is currently looking for hardworking and dedicated Press Brake Operator to join their team.
  
The Press Brake Operator is responsible for setting up and operating CNC press brake machinery to bend, form, and fabricate sheet metal components in accordance with engineering drawings and production specifications. The role ensures products are manufactured accurately, efficiently, and to the required quality standards while maintaining a safe working environment.

Key Responsibilities
Set up and operate CNC press brakes
Program and operate press brakes, when necessary, not mandatory
Select correct tooling and develop bend sequences
Read and interpret engineering drawings
Perform first-off and in-process quality checks
Maintain productivity and quality standards during night shift
Troubleshoot bending issues and adjust programs where required
Maintain a clean and safe workspace

Skills & Experience
At least 2 years of relevant experience 
Relevant qualification
Proven experience as a Press Brake Operator
Experience working with CNC press brake machines
Ability to work independently without supervision
Strong sheet metal fabrication knowledge
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings
High attention to detail and quality


If you think you have got the skills and experience to join our team, please apply now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
